dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: What is it? Something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: The festival might be a good time, but let me just say this first: don't you make any trouble for Ms. Kageyama!

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: What is it? Something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you tell me more about Ritou?

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: The entirety of Ritou falls under the jurisdiction of the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: While the Sakoku Decree is in effect, an outlander such as yourself must verify your identity and report your itinerary whether you are entering, leaving, or staying.

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: Don't say that I didn't remind you. If you are rude to Miss Kageyama... Ahem, I mean the inspector, you will be deported right away.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about the Sakoku Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: Hmph, what else do you need to know? Since it's the decision of our Almighty Shogun, many careful considerations must have been made.

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: It's not a matter for people such as ourselves to discuss... Let alone outlanders like you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: Stop idling about here. Hurry up and cooperate with the work of the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who is Miss Kageyama?

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: You don't even know who Miss Kageyama is? I don't think you should be in Ritou!

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: Miss Kageyama is an inspector at the Outlander Affairs Agency who is in charge of entry permits for outlanders like you.

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: If you still wish to remain in Inazuma, you'd better get those documents and gifts prepared before visiting the inspector!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you tell me more about Ritou?

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: The entirety of Ritou falls under the jurisdiction of the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: As long as you're looking to do business in Ritou, whether it be importing goods or opening a shop, you must first verify your identity and get all the relevant information on record.

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: Don't say that I didn't remind you. If you are rude to Ms. Kageyama... Ahem, I mean the inspector, you will be deported right away.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who is Ms. Kageyama?

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: You don't even know who Ms. Kageyama is? I don't think you should be in Ritou!

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: Miss Kageyama is an inspector at the Outlander Affairs Agency who is in charge of keeping an eye out for outlanders like you.

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: There sure are lot more outlanders now the Sakoku Decree has been abolished... Looks like Ms. Kageyama's job is about to get a whole lot busier...

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: If only I could help her out...

dialogues.speaker: Ebina Gonshirou
dialogues.text: *cough* Ahem. Whatever the case, if you wish to have a decent time in Ritou, you'd better get those documents and gifts prepared before visiting the inspector!
